text: Planning a trip can be exciting but also stressful. First, you need to choose a destination and book your flights and hotel. When you arrive, you will experience new cultures, traditions and ways of life. Trying local food is one of the best parts of travelling because it helps you understand the place better. However, language barriers can sometimes cause problems, so it is useful to learn a few basic words. Even small mistakes can become funny stories later. In the end, travel creates unforgettable memories that stay with you for a lifetime.
